name: @openagenthub/cli
description: OpenAgentHub CLI: install, run, publish and manage AI agents

env.description: Manage encrypted secrets for an agent

dashboard.description: Manage the local control plane (dashboard daemon)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/commands/*.ts src/commands/sandbox/*.ts src/lib/*.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --outbase=src --splitting --external:@oclif/core && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('../node_modules/@openagenthub/sdk/dist/schema','dist/schema',{recursive:true})"
